leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a graph representation of words where edges connect words differing by a single letter.
Initialize a queue data structure to implement a breadth-first search for the shortest transformation path.
Manipulate a visited set to prevent cycles and ensure efficient traversal of the word graph.
Apply a neighbor generation function to find all valid one-letter transformations of a given word.
Integrate a dictionary lookup to validate candidate words during the search process.
Configure the BFS algorithm to track the transformation path from the start word to the target word.
Implement the complete word ladder function that returns the shortest sequence or an empty result if none exists.
